_source: Callaway-Sant'Anna dynamic aggregation (aggte(cs_fit$att_gt, type='dynamic')), confirmed run in src/06_estimate.R; pre-trend cell independently re-verified via the raw group-time att_gt table (out$group/t/att/se) during the pre-trend diagnostic investigation (PROJECT_PLAN.md Week 4).
band_type: 95% simultaneous confidence band (corrects for testing multiple event-times at once)

pretrend_diagnosis.explanation: This is exactly 1 of 16 group-time cells in the full att_gt decomposition. Confirmed NOT a DC artifact: excluding DC (a single jurisdiction, high-leverage by construction) moves the estimate only to -0.0092 -- Maryland and Michigan carry this, not DC. Confirmed NOT resolved by allowing anticipation (anticipation=2 in att_gt() leaves the -6 cell significant). Read as a genuine, unexplained pre-existing difference specific to Maryland/Michigan predating their 2024 treatment by 6 years -- a caveat on the 2024 cohort's contribution, not evidence the whole panel violates parallel trends.
